label: Self & personality
scope: Identity, personality, emotions, personal growth and the values guiding one's own life.

label: Identity & self-worth
scope: Who I am, how others see me, authenticity, self-image, proving my worth.

label: Authenticity & self-presentation
scope: Hiding, revealing or performing parts of yourself.

label: Self-worth & recognition
scope: Feeling worthy, being valued, earning recognition or needing approval.

label: Emotions & coping
scope: Feeling fear, anger, grief or joy and how a person handles an emotional response.

label: Stress & overwhelm
scope: Coping with stress, pressure or emotional overload.

label: Fear & uncertainty
scope: Fears, vulnerability and responses to uncertainty.

label: Growth & change
scope: Changing yourself, learning from personal setbacks, motivation, perseverance.

label: Memories & milestones
scope: Recalling childhood experiences, an important life event or a turning point in one's personal history.

label: Values & purpose
scope: Personal priorities, changing beliefs, fulfillment, purpose and what makes a choice meaningful.

label: Personality frameworks
scope: Using an explicit personality typology to understand people or themselves.

label: Enneagram
scope: Understanding the Enneagram, numbered personality types, wings or instincts.

label: Relationships & belonging
scope: Family, partners, friends, community and interactions between people.

label: Family & upbringing
scope: Being a parent, child or relative, and life within a family.

label: Parenting & caregiving
scope: Raising or guiding one's children and choices made by a parent for a child.

label: Parental expectations
scope: How parents' hopes or pressure shape their children's choices or performance.

label: Family roles & dynamics
scope: The role a relative plays in the household, sibling dynamics or how relatives divide family obligations.

label: Dating & partnerships
scope: Dating, intimacy, committed partnerships, marriage or breakups.

label: Dating & courtship
scope: Choosing dates, dating activities and finding a romantic partner.

label: Marriage & long-term partnership
scope: Married life and sustaining a committed partnership.

label: Friendship
scope: Making, defining or maintaining friendships and interactions between friends.

label: Community & belonging
scope: Finding a community, belonging to groups, inclusion and social trust.

label: Communication & conflict
scope: Speaking up, interpreting another person's words, boundaries, disagreements and repair.

label: Work, learning & money
scope: Careers, the workplace, business, education, acquiring skills and managing money.

label: Careers & working life
scope: Career choices, jobs, professional identity, relationships and recognition at work.

label: Workplace relationships
scope: Interactions between colleagues, office politics and workplace credit.

label: Business & leadership
scope: Running companies, building ventures, leading people and business decisions.

label: School & skills
scope: School experience, college decisions, formal education and learning specific skills.

label: College & higher education
scope: Deciding whether, where or what to study in college.

label: Personal finances
scope: Earning, budgeting, debt, investing personal savings and household finances.

label: Health & everyday life
scope: Physical and mental health, daily routines, food, travel and everyday practical choices.

label: Physical & mental health
scope: Conditions, treatment, health practices and the effect of strain on health.

label: Habits & routines
scope: Recurring activities, daily habits, time use, mornings and evenings.

label: Food & home life
scope: Cooking, meals, maintaining a home and household routines.

label: Travel & getting around
scope: Trips, transit, air travel and how people get from place to place.

label: Culture, sports & leisure
scope: Playing or watching sports, hobbies, art, books, music, entertainment and media.

label: Sports & competition
scope: Athletic activities, athletes, teams, coaching, fandom and competition in organized sports.

label: Youth sports
scope: Children or teens playing organized sports, including school teams and coaching.

label: Pressure on young athletes
scope: The experience of performance expectations, burnout or coercion in youth athletics.

label: Sports fandom
scope: Watching, following or supporting teams and athletes.

label: Arts, books & entertainment
scope: Reading, music, film, art, creative practice and choosing what to read or watch.

label: Books & reading
scope: Choosing, reading or discussing books and literature.

label: Hobbies & play
scope: Play for its own sake, collecting, crafts, tabletop games, toys and recreational pastimes outside athletics or the arts.

label: Media & online culture
scope: Social media use and norms, media influence, online audiences and popular culture.

label: Society & public life
scope: Government, politics, law, collective ethics, religion, social institutions and history.

label: Politics & government
scope: Elections, political beliefs, parties, policy, public office and international affairs.

label: Elections & voting
scope: Voters, candidates and election choices.

label: Political beliefs & parties
scope: Partisanship, changing political views and differences between parties.

label: International affairs
scope: Relations and conflicts between governments.

label: Ethics & justice
scope: Examining a moral principle, a conflict between duties, fairness, rights, laws or systems of justice.

label: Faith & traditions
scope: Religion, spiritual practice and cultural traditions.

label: History & social change
scope: Historical events, social movements, customs over time and societal change.

label: Economics & policy
scope: Markets, economic systems, employment policy and the distribution of public resources.

label: Science, technology & environment
scope: The natural world, scientific knowledge, digital tools, infrastructure and environmental systems.

label: Technology & digital tools
scope: Devices, software, AI, technical skills and how technologies function or are used.

label: Science & discovery
scope: Scientific methods, findings, the physical universe and scientific explanations.

label: Environment & infrastructure
scope: Climate, ecosystems, food systems, sustainability and built infrastructure.
